text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came to the library to look for Zenno 
Rob Roy, but...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... Just a little since this 
morning... It happens occasionally when my 
circulation gets poor.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
You stay in the same posture while 
reading, after all. I tried to be careful 
by rolling my neck occasionally, but even 
so...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Still, I cannot neglect inventorying the 
books. As a library committee member—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I can't get any work done like 
this...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy ended up suffering from a 
headache for a while...
